notes.title: 【Update content】New turret: Exterminator!
notes.notes:
Hello, players!

This update introduces a new turret: the Exterminator. Additionally, adjustments have been made to certain gears and XENs.

At the same time, the Gamma corps, originally seen at Dawn Base, will now join the battlefield in Tour Mode. Below are the detailed update notes:

 will have a special discount starting November 20 PT. Don't miss it if you are interested!

New Challenge Levels:
- Training: Armor Breach – Unlocked by default.
- Training: Kronos Hunt – Unlocked by default.
New Building Components:
- Turret: Exterminator – Unlocks for research after acquiring the [Exterminator Blueprint].
- Decoration: Signboard – Obtainable upon completing the challenge Training: Armor Breach and unlocks relevant permissions.
- Decoration: Medal Frame – Obtainable after completing the challenge Training: Kronos Hunt.
New Equipment:
- Lightweight Armor – Increases the character’s movement speed while firing on the move.
- Override Helmet – Reworked function; now you can use [middle mouse button] to pin certain enemies, and the turrets under your control will prioritize them.
New XEN:
- Skill XEN: Precision - fires high-pressure rounds designed to target enemy weak points.
- Buff XEN: Penetration - Increases damage when hitting enemy weak points.
The Gamma Corps officially make their appearance in Tour mode Mode (Snow Ruins and City Ruins).
Several new level events have been added.

Adjustments:
XEN Adjustments:
- Explosive Arrow cooldown reduced from 15s to 10s.
- Energy Arc duration increased from 2s to 3s.
- Spray Cannon explosion radius increased from 2m to 3.33m.
- Grenade explosion radius increased from 3m to 3.33m.
- Divine Might cooldown reduced from 5s to 3s.
- Re-Initialize cooldown reduced from 20s to 10s.
- Beam cooldown reduced from 15s to 10s, range increased from 25m to 50m.
- Missile cooldown reduced from 25s to 15s.
- Slasher Round cooldown reduced from 18s to 15s, ammo capacity increased from 50 to 60.
- Scatter Grenade cooldown reduced from 16s to 10s.
- Mark duration increased from 5s to 10s.
Equipment Adjustments:
- Optimized the mounting effect of the Mounting Underbarrel, now it's easier to mount your gun on the cover. Also, a visual hint near the crosshair is implemented.
- Improved the Engineering Helmet function, now the helmet's effect will also be trigger when you use “Reload” XEN.
- Weak Point Helmet damage calculation now considers actual hit damage and is counted as energy damage.
- Increased the grappling range and usability of Mechanical Claw.
Character Adjustments:
- The Pyro Missile Barrage gains a new sub-trait, "Extension," allowing multiple Pyro Missile to be fired instantly.
- Additional new traits have been added to all squads.
Optimizations:
- Enhanced the middle mouse button pin system for better usability in first-person mode.
- Adjusted the placement collision range of Hellfire, allowing closer placement for parallel setups.
- Improved cooldown display while controlling multiple cannons in RTS mode.
- Improved the position of damage numbers when Chain XEN hits Kronos.
- Completing Main Mission now rewards extra Efficiency Pts. for accelerating research.
- A new merchant, Holly, has been added to the Trade Port, selling low-quality equipment.
Fixes:
- Resolved occasional game crashes while boarding transport for evacuation.
- Fixed possible crashes when switching scenes.
- Fixed an issue in the AETOS Observation level where the mission couldn’t proceed.
- Fixed high-explosive and RPGs charges not damaging to debris and trees.
- Corrected some AoE XEN not benefiting from critical hit effect XEN.
- Fixed the issue of the Xenium Bomber sac causing ice damage.
- Fixed the issue that standard and pyro grenades have no collision with terrain or enemies.
- Corrected Kronos's missiles mistakenly targeting scenery structures.
- Fixed issue where selecting both upgraded and non-upgraded Spike for batch upgrade overwrote the upgraded Spikes’ effects.
- Fixed issue where Storm Apostle's shield remained after death.
- Fixed an error where items could be mistakenly placed into the Container when using items in front of it.
- Fixed issue with directional missile silo where missiles didn’t display damage numbers upon impact.
- Addressed a speed-up anomaly in Kronos’s audio during the AETOS Observation level.
- Corrected inconsistency between activation and display of the damage boost effect in the Precision event.
- Fixed a model residue issue with 406mm Cruiser Cannon from events where the initial cannon barrel position would remain.
- Fixed tips repeatedly triggering [You've reached the border and can't move out of bounds.] Hints if players have moved to the border in RTS mode during sandstorm weather.
- Fixed missing wave display in Return to Dawn base Mode.
- Resolved an issue in the Shooting Range where, after resetting targets, the damage stats panel failed to accurately track damage dealt.
- Fixed an issue where items carried by Pack Mule were not correctly returned to the base warehouse after boarding the recovery aircraft as expected.

notes.title: FPS base builder Outpost Infinity Siege bounces back with huge update
notes.notes:
Success is a fickle thing in gaming. It can strike quickly and without warning and can disappear as easily. For some games like Outpost: Infinity Siege, it can even strike twice. At launch back in March, it hit a solid player base but that quickly dwindled, leaving it with only a few hundred players at any one time. Now, things might be turning around for the game thanks to a huge patch that has added some new stuff and changed up plenty more.

Dear Commanders, we have received everyone’s feedback. Today's adjustments focus on the difficulty and content unlocked in [Return to Dawn Base].
Patch has been deployed, please refer to the details below for more information. Please note that some of the changes/bug fixes will affect the game's difficulty.

## [Gameplay Adjustment]
1.Overall Difficulty: Reduced the monster strength in single-player mode for all challenges.
2.Gameplay: The [Small Package] challenge now includes a [Large Artillery Formation] event by default, allowing players to better handle the Kronos in the last wave.
3.Free Mode unlock condition changed: Unlocks after completing the [Matchbox] challenge.
4.Unlock Method for [XEN Turrets]: Now unlocked through Research:
  a.Light XEN Turret: Unlocked with [30mm Light Guns] research.
  b.Medium XEN Turret: Unlocked with [CIWS] research.
  c.Heavy XEN Turret: Unlocked with [Hellfire] research.
  d.Charged XEN Turret: Unlocked with [Twin Barrel 105mm Artillery] research. 
If players have previously researched these turrets, they will be unlocked upon logging into the game.
5.Gameplay Adjustment: The insect swarm summoning skill of the Crius in [Ultimate Wave] has been changed from summoning 3 swarms per call to 1 swarm.

## [BUG FIXES]
1.Fixed issue where an operative ATK buff was applied to turrets by mistake.
2.Fixed an issue where enemies' AI would treat the turrets mounted on heavy mechs as separate attack targets.
3.Fixed the overexposure of random event resource pod icon at night time.

notes.title: 【Major Update】 launched! Numerous new contents added!
notes.notes:
Dear Commanders, thanks for your support and patience! Phase 2 has updated with planned content, and more adjustments as well as optimization. Hope you'll like it! 
Today's patch has been deployed, please refer to the details below for more information. Please note that some of the changes/bug Fixes will affect the game's difficulty.

[Crucial Adjustment]

1.Optimization on [Edit Mode]
Greatly changed the Edit Mode interface, including the operation experience and information display, while adding some convenient construction operations.

a.Batch Construction:
By selecting the component, press and hold the left button to batch construct. Please note that it can only be operated horizontally.
b.Multiple Select/Move/Remove:
Hold left button to select multiple components. Selected components can be detached/moved/rotated/removed together. 
Please note that there is a limitation of selectable components for once. Moving too many components at one time together may lead to performance issue. Players can adjust the limitation of the components that can be selected in the settings.
c.Lock Components (Selection Filter):
Locked components will not be selected when editing.
d.Batch Rotation:
To rotate the entire outpost 180 degrees.
e.Horizontal Movement:
To move all the selected components together horizontally in four direction.
f.Redirection to [CRAFT]:
Right click a component in the listto redirect to the [CRAFT] page.
g.Tutorials and Tips:
More tutorials and tips for [Edit Mode]: Instructions can be found in the left bottom corner in Edit Mode screen. You can jump to in-game WIKI by clicking them.
h.Optimized the operation experience:
Added some shortcut keys, such as the [Tab] button to switch between "Edit Mode" and "Config Mode". Optimized the basic operation mechanism including attachment and rotation.

2.Stability Mechanism Optimization
Structural Components deployed on the A.T.C are consider stable and supported, without a mandatory need to be connected with the slots.

3.Promethean Core Mechanism Optimization
a.In Recovery Day or in Infinity Siege, you will not find a frountline from the start of the battle. Now you will find a [Core Base] on the site of the frontline. And you will have to build a frontline yourself.
b.Players should build Promethean Core with the consumption of power and materials. Please make sure the surrounding is clear of enemies or players to avoid getting stuck. When a frontline is completed, it will have certain components within(such as Combat Miner and MG turret). When a frontline is standing, all enemy drop pods on that route will be pushed further away from your outpost. 
c.When a frontline is destroyed, it can be re-constructed.
d.When a frontline is destroyed, it stops attacking enemies nearby.

4.Turret Overload
In Command Mode, you can now select certain turrets and go [Overload] by consuming power, to greatly increase its combat capability for a short time, such as the firing rate, ATK and distance. Unlock after researched.

5.Loot spawn of POIs: 
re-arrange the loot spawn positions for all POIs. Advanced materials now show in a more reasonable position in a relatively stable way. Players are more likely to loot advanced materials in landmark now.

6.[Core Output] mechanism:
a.Increased the Damage Amp limit to 500%, with 10,000 core output.
b.Increased the X-Boost Field limit to 180 meters, with 10,000 core output.
c.The upper limit of the core output bonus for the defense level of characters in the X-Boost Field has been adjusted to 500.
d.Added clearer effect display.

[Outpost]
1.New Assault Component: Rocket Array

Unlock research by clearing [City Ruins] on Difficulty I and [Mine Launcher] researched.
Rocket Array shots high explosive rockets missiles, causing Kinetic Damage with 15 Mag Size reload by consuming materials only.

Rocket Array has four different launch methods: 

a.Auto Fire
b.Manual Fire by pressing and selecting the bombardment location (like Artillery)
c.Manual Fire under FPS mode
d.Clear Fire: Pour all remaining ammo into an area.

2.New Assault Component: Electromagnetic Cruiser Cannon
a.Unlock Research after [Earth United Army] mission and [406mm Cruiser Cannon] researched.
b.Electromagnetic Cruiser Cannon has a higher steering speed than common 406mm Cruiser Cannon with higher projectile speed and direct damage, leading to greater Electro Damage.
c.Added [Single Round] as default fire mode, each Barrel will take turns firing. Players can switch to [Clear Fire] in the Command Mode. Optimized the related visual effects and audio effects.

3.New Cosmetic Component: Chair
a.Unlock Manufacture by clearing [Snow Ruins] on Difficulty I.
b.Players can sit on the Chair as a Cosmetic Component.

4.New Modular Component: 1 Meter Conveyor Belt
a.Unlock Manufacture after [Conveyor Belt] researched.
b.Conveyor Belt with smaller size. It is recommended to used with 3 meter Conveyor Belt. Please note that overuse may lead to performance issues.
c.Optimized the conveyor belt's transmission, reducing the situation where ammo boxes may get stuck.

5.New Structural Component: L-shaped Barrier
a.Unlock Manufacture after [Barrier] researched. 
b.It is suggested to be placed on the diagonal edge of a L-shaped floor.

6.New Support Facility: Spring Trap
a.Unlock Manufacture after [Vertical Springboard] researched.  
b.Players can deploy Support Facility: Spring Trap in battlefield with its help.
c.Enemies or other players who step on it will be ejected into the air. Unlock research for further upgrades to enhance with freeze, vulnerability and Damage Amp.

7.New Support Unit: Supporter (Guardian Varient)
a.[Advanced Guardian Fabricator] can produce [Supporter] which auto-pick up the ammo boxes and replenish ammunition for other support units and turrets in the nearby. (4 ammo boxes stackable)
b.Equip Repair Turrets on Supporters to enable them to heal nearby allies.

8.Missile Silo Mechanism Optimization
Added 2 new missiles for Missile Silo
a.Cryo Missile:deals Cryo damage to enemies nearby.
b.Dismantle Missile: dismantle the items nearby and transfer into materials after hitting.

9.Mine Launcher Mechanism Optimization
a.Added a Cryo Launcher that deals Cryo damage to enemies 
b.Optimized the explosion effects of Launcher.

10.Assembly site for Guardian Fabricator:
a.Right click the ground to set an assembly site for [Guardian Fabricator] and [Advanced Guardian Fabricator]. 
b.Guardians will gather at the assembly site after they have been fabricated.

11.Optimized the logic of each type of Guardians to reduce the situation where their firing lines are blocked by each other.

12.Adjusted the range of CIWS, Type 30 CIWS to 8,000.

13.[Small Artillery Formation Upgrade - 30mm Light Turret] is unlocked by default. Decreased power consumption from 20 to 5.

notes.title: [Patch Notes] Optimization and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Commanders, we appreciate your patience.
We have recently deployed a patch that rectifies various crashes and bugs. Also, we are foucusing on the following issues that have been widely discussed by the player community:
1. We are endeavoring to alleviate the issue of the game's early stages being excessively grind-heavy. 
2. We are working on enhancing the rewards from combat encounters during Exploration Days.
3. Efforts are being made to optimize the time distribution between exploration and tower defense activities. 
Furthermore, we are actively engaging in discussions to refine the Co-op gameplay experience. 
We kindly request additional time to address these matters. 

The specific update log is as follows:

Character
